text:
jess: Quick question — should the Console persist per-route filters when you navigate away? e.g. on a model route I set `latency>100` and then hop to another route and come back — keep it or reset? :thinking:

omar: My vote: persist by default for the route+model combo, but scoped to the user unless they click "Save view". Avoid polluting global saved views. Ephemeral state + explicit save CTA.

liam: worried about state explosion. If we auto-persist per-user per-route for every combo we'll end up with tons of entries. Propose TTL (30d) and show "last used" in the dropdown. Org admins can set defaults.

jess: TTL makes sense. UX question: where should the "Save as preset" UI live — inline near the filters, or in the header next to the route name?

mara: inline next to filters is more discoverable. Small modal on save that asks for name + visibility (private/team/org).

omar: visibility semantics need to be explicit: private = only you, team = your team (how defined?), org = everyone. Also stash ownership metadata so creators can transfer ownership or delete.

dev-console-bot: feature-flag deployed: `analytics-persistent-filters=true`

liam: here's a sample saved view object we could store for prototyping:

```json
{
  "name": "High latency models",
  "scope": "team",
  "route": "/models/:id",
  "filters": ["p50>200", "model_family:llama"],
  "expires_at": "2025-02-10T00:00:00Z"
}
```

jess: UX notes: when a route has saved views, show a compact pill list collapsed by default with a "Manage" link. Show creator and last-used timestamp on hover.

mara: can we reuse the existing bookmarks modal + permissions model? that could save dev time.

omar: a couple operational things: backend needs indexing for search across route-scoped views and we should emit telemetry events `view.apply`, `view.save`, `view.delete`. Telemetry should be opt-in by org. Also watch read/write patterns if TTL + autosave used heavily.

jess: action items: 1) prototype inline save button & modal (mara) 2) design backend TTL + scope + transfer ownership (omar) 3) dropdown UX with recent views + manage page (liam). I'll schedule a 20m sync Thurs 11:00am to review prototype. @mara @omar @liam

mara: ack :thumbsup:
